mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP3A4 and may increase metabolism of cyanocobalamin; rifampin also impairs gastrointestinal absorption of vitamin B12 through enzyme induction and effects on enterohepatic circulation.
action: Monitor vitamin B12 levels periodically during concurrent use and consider B12 supplementation if deficiency develops; increased monitoring is particularly important in patients with baseline B12 deficiency or malabsorption.
